reviews.x: This hair is amazing. This is my third time ordering from this company and I will continue to order in the future. The ends are full, the hair is so soft, and there is no chemical smell like other companies. The is no shedding, no tangling, and it is very silky and straight. Shipping was fast too, only two days. The seller was very nice and helpful. No issues at all. I recommend this hair to everyone I come across and have received many compliments. I love this hair.

claims.text: Many reviewers describe the hair as very soft and silky.
Several reviewers report the hair is true to length with full ends and good value.
Some reviewers say the hair behaves like synthetic, melting or shriveling when flat ironed.
A number of reviewers complain the bundles are thin and rough.
Some reviewers report tangling and shedding, while others say there is none.
